name: Appointment
description: Represents a scheduled medical appointment between a patient and a doctor.

attributes.name: idOfUser
attributes.description: Owning user (patient) — set automatically on create from the authenticated user; only the owning patient or an admin/doctor may update or delete their appointment.

attributes.name: patientId
attributes.description: Foreign key to the Patient entity for the patient attending the appointment.

attributes.name: doctorId
attributes.description: Foreign key to the Doctor entity for the doctor conducting the appointment.

attributes.name: appointmentDateTime
attributes.description: The scheduled date and time of the appointment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current status of the appointment.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or details about the appointment.
